page.overview:
Who is Bradford Kennedy?

Bradford Kennedy is a American intelligence operative employed by the CIA and on loan to the British MI6. The character appeared in the 2015 video-game, James Bond: World of Espionage.

Cool headed, loyal and a crack shot, Bradford is the best the CIA has to offer. In the second year of his exchange programme working with MI6, he finds the British culture as alien as California.

Noted for his overconfidence, he has skills in firearms, hand-to-hand combat and driving, and is multi-lingual, speaking English, Spanish and Arabic. The character offers a buff which reduces damage taken and provides a 2% chance to gain 1250 bonus money from Missions using reinforced vests, along with a +5 energy bonus using smoke bombs. He is a "common agent" (white) character and can be levelled to level 5.
